decision: NO_GO: Ligue1 probability scores worsen and overall final ECE worsens; no operational adoption.
hypothesis: Replace unsupported zero leaf contributions with a training-support-weighted nearest-supported-ancestor contribution, preserving every supported leaf and all original training raw predictions. Zero is an additive tree contribution, not a zero forecast; this extrapolation assumption may add bias and is not a demonstrated bug fix.

intervention.ancestorOrder: Keep split bits 0..k-1; decrease k from depth-1 to0; first prefix with positive original training support. Never use already-filled values in weighted means.
intervention.calibration: Mandatory refit using the unchanged current binned isotonic estimator and the same original358 calibration rows after tree edit. No plateau correction, no choice between calibrators.

calibrationAlgebraicAttribution.method: Exact two-factor telescoping attribution, averaged over both factor orders; mixed intermediate partitions are mathematical attribution only, not candidate evaluations.

limitations: Retrospective decomposition of the already-scored candidate; no new hypothesis validation.
Changing input and refitting calibration jointly prevents causal attribution to either alone.
Closing odds are historical diagnostic evidence, not a verified forecast-time capture.
One post-fit extrapolation assumption, not a proven CatBoost bug; additive zero does not mean zero forecast.
Original split ordering determines the prefix; some filled leaves are unreachable.
Same original358 refitted calibration changes all diagnostic probabilities even when the raw matrix is unchanged.
652 outcomes were already consulted; research adaptivity remains despite freezing this one rule before its scoring.
Nominal paired weekly intervals condition on fitted models and omit selection adjustment; they cannot certify future benefit.
Current57 games span only two UTC week blocks.
No per-league exception, second variant or modified pass criterion after results.
